page.title: Elo against real Onyx match prices
summary: Every game priced only from results before it, against Onyx's real opening and closing lines. The rule was chosen on games before 2026-01-01 and judged on 2026-01-01 on, which it never saw.
On the tuning window the best blend gave the model no weight: Onyx's own price was better on its own.
Not passed: the lane lost money at opening prices; the lane lost money at closing prices. Leans only until it does.
